description: What to do if a peaceful protest you are in is being broken up.

steps.text: Stay calm and keep your hands visible; do not run or fight.
Peaceful assembly is your right (s.40); a peaceful protest is not a crime.
If ordered to leave, move calmly; do not give a reason to be arrested.
No one may beat or treat you in an inhuman way (s.34(1)).
If arrested, ask on what grounds and remain silent until your lawyer comes.
Note officers' names, numbers, and record events if it is safe.
Call a lawyer or trusted person if anyone is detained or hurt.
